title: Security URL Validation & Transport
summary: This module provides functionalities for validating URLs against Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) policies and creating SSRF-safe HTTP clients. It ensures that network requests do not target unauthorized internal resources.

nodes.label: Validate URL (Async)
nodes.title: Asynchronous URL Validation
nodes.description: Performs comprehensive URL validation, including DNS resolution, against SSRF policies to prevent unauthorized access to internal resources.

nodes.label: Check URL Safety
nodes.title: Boolean URL Safety Check
nodes.description: Provides a non-throwing method to determine if a given URL is safe according to the configured SSRF policy, returning true or false.

nodes.label: Strict SSRF Validation
nodes.title: Pydantic Strict SSRF Policy
nodes.description: A Pydantic validator enforcing strict SSRF protection, disallowing private IP addresses while permitting both HTTP and HTTPS schemes.

nodes.label: HTTPS-Only SSRF Validation
nodes.title: Pydantic HTTPS-Only SSRF Policy
nodes.description: A Pydantic validator enforcing SSRF protection that requires HTTPS and disallows private IP addresses.

nodes.label: Relaxed SSRF Validation
nodes.title: Pydantic Relaxed SSRF Policy
nodes.description: A Pydantic validator for SSRF protection that allows private IP addresses and both HTTP/HTTPS schemes.

nodes.label: Create SSRF-Safe HTTP Client
nodes.title: SSRF-Protected HTTP Client
nodes.description: Constructs an `httpx.AsyncClient` instance pre-configured with an SSRF-safe transport layer to enforce security policies on outgoing requests.

nodes.label: SSRF Policy Definition
nodes.title: SSRF Policy Configuration
nodes.description: Defines the rules and constraints (e.g., allowed hosts, private IP restrictions) that govern URL validation and SSRF protection.

nodes.label: Async HTTP Client
nodes.title: External Async HTTP Client
nodes.description: The underlying asynchronous HTTP client library (`httpx`) used for making network requests, integrated with SSRF protection.

groups.label: URL Validation Core
groups.title: Core URL Validation Functions
groups.description: Primary functions for directly validating URLs against SSRF policies, including asynchronous checks and simple safety checks.

groups.label: Pydantic Validators
groups.title: Pydantic Model Integration for SSRF
groups.description: Pydantic-compatible validators that apply different levels of SSRF protection (strict, HTTPS-only, relaxed) to URL fields in data models.

groups.label: HTTP Client Integration
groups.title: SSRF-Safe HTTP Client Creation
groups.description: Functionality to create an asynchronous HTTP client (`httpx`) that automatically enforces SSRF policies on all outgoing requests.

groups.label: Policy Configuration
groups.title: SSRF Policy Definition
groups.description: Represents the configuration object that dictates the rules and parameters for Server-Side Request Forgery protection.
